path.note: Calls 1 and 2 of each (bsz=1, q_len=1) slot were discarded one-token decodes at position 0 (eager _gr warmup, then CUDA graph capture+launch). The 300 saved steps are calls 3..302, graph replay only. Embedding, RMSNorm, residual add, and lm_head are direct launches outside those graphs. Activation clones run after each wrapped forward returns and are not inside the capture. num_splits is split_config(block_table.size(1), page_size=256, q_len=1, block_n, splits_cap) with block_n and splits_cap from BCAttn._configure. block_table.size(1) is the width iterate_gen stages, padded up to a multiple of 16 pages (generator.py). page_boundary_positions are cache positions that open a new 256-token page (position > 0 and position % 256 == 0), the cache_seqlens of the first forward after Job.receive_sample sees page_after > page_before. num_splits_change_positions lists those cache positions where num_splits differs from the previous step.
